meta.title: Sydney Harbour core

verticalScale.bridgeDeck: stylized sine profile peaking at 30 m so the span meets the ground at both mapped ends
verticalScale.bridgeArch: original stylized truss, not a surveyed model and not the real 134 m arch
verticalScale.operaShells: original stylized shells aligned to the OSM footprint
verticalScale.estimatedBuildingHeights: used only where OSM has neither height nor building:levels

meta.imagery: No aerial photography and no photogrammetry. Ground colours are procedural.
limits: Road, coastline, water, park, pier, and building footprints are simplified OpenStreetMap geometries for the bbox, not a full-city twin.

OpenStreetMap building footprints with height or building:levels are kept, tallest first, up to 2200. Untagged footprints are omitted instead of being given invented tower heights. If that cap is not full, leftovers get a modest deterministic estimate marked heightSource=estimated.
The Opera House shells and Harbour Bridge arch, pylons, and deck profile are original stylized models. Only their plan position comes from OpenStreetMap.
No Google photogrammetry, no Bing/Maxar imagery, and no Microsoft building-footprint dump.
